evidence: Authored for this product: no template placeholder survives (grep for CHANGE_ME, patchpad, incident, gridforge over the frozen task's md/toml/json/sh/ts/tsx/html returned nothing; the template's instruction.md is the single line 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.'). instruction.md is a first-person product request specific to a code playground ('I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source'). task.toml carries its own identity: name 'turing/colderwater-playground-devtools', arena_slice 'custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history', provenance 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task.' The product name is used consistently (app_context.md 'Name: Colderwater playground'; all five prompt.md files open 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground'). Not a nouns-swapped clone: the nearest sibling is the PatchPad family (patchpad-editor, -v2, -v3: 'custom incident-report editor', arena_slice 'full-stack-node-express-sqlite-custom-editor'). The two share the custom-editing-surface family, so about 16 of the 43 functional criteria have a conceptual counterpart there (typing/line join, caret navigation, graphemes, mouse selection, paste undo, block indent, multi-caret typing/delete, find, replace current/all, save-reload-restart, stale save, history restore). The other roughly 27 have no counterpart in any sibling: cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring, cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_format_error_keeps_draft, cw_basic_run_output, cw_html_preview, cw_error_message_and_line, cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line, cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_run_starts_fresh_document, cw_console_levels_in_order, cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_time_limit_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_preview_isolation, cw_dynamic_code_refused, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe, cw_live_library_update, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft, plus cw_same_line_carets, cw_undo_restores_caret, cw_replace_self_containing_text, cw_caret_kept_in_view. Conversely PatchPad's seed_document_integrity, manifest_documents_runtime_routes, direct_api_save_rejection_nonmutation_matrix, word_navigation_and_selection_shortcuts and clipboard_external_multiline_internal_exact have no Colderwater counterpart; PatchPad seeds one incident report while Colderwater's seed is '"snippets": []' and the app has no sign-in. Even the overlapping criteria are written in this product's terms (e.g. cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic requires 'one real Alt+Click and one real Ctrl/Cmd+Click' and a slow MUL/TI burst, traceable to ui.md 'The burst lasts for as long as I keep typing at those carets, however slowly'). No other sibling (spreadsheet, canvas, chat, games, back-office desks) is a code playground or devtools product, so the task occupies its own slot in the suite. NOTES: (1) No written suite domain plan was found in the frozen rules or the workspace authoring docs, so 'fits the domain plan' is judged only against the sibling set and the task's own arena_slice; this is not a measurement gap for this row. (2) The suite already holds three PatchPad variants in the same custom-editor family; the overlap is partial and bounded, not a defect of this task. (3) Evidence-index hashes: 18 of 22 artifacts match byte-for-byte in cw-strict-worktree; the four files of run 4e686738 (result.json, verifier/reward.json, verifier/scored/reward-details.json, verifier/gates/reward-details.json) hash differently on disk only because the worktree checkout has CRLF line endings; their LF-normalised bytes and the committed blob (git show HEAD:...reward.json = bcfe3714...) match the index. Those runs are on an earlier candidate and do not bear on this row. (4) Run directories are spelled 'coldwater' while the task is 'colderwater'; this is outside the task bytes.
